name: ruby-rescue-nil-save

rescue StandardError

end

name: ruby-wrap-network-failure
label: BENIGN
why: Raises a contextual error after logging a failed request.

after.fetch.rb:
def fetch(client)
  client.get
rescue IOError => error
  warn error.message
  raise IOError, "fetch failed: #{error.message}"
end
